sources.evidenceSummary: Retrospective of OCG 2008.03–2012.09 formats, used for annual archetype context; cards still obey each calendar-year cutoff.

decks.title: 黑羽疾风
decks.description: 参考2009世界冠军 Benjamin Tan 的黑羽战术。黑旋风检索、月影保护战斗，暴雪衔接同调；用鸟兽解放和墓地资源争取节奏。
main: Blackwing - Vayu the Emblem of Honor
extra: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
combo: 先发动黑旋风，再通常召唤黑羽；只能检索攻击力更低的同伴。
大旆从墓地除外自身与非调整黑羽，登场的黑羽同调效果无效。
decks.sideSourceStatus: The source supplied no complete Side Deck. These 15 game-adapted counterplay cards cover graveyard interaction, summon interruption and back-row or monster removal within the OCG candidate year. They are not a player-original transcription.

decks.title: 猫剑斗兽
decks.description: 参考2009世界亚军 Chien Yen Jui 的猫剑斗兽。救援猫提供低星素材，剑斗兽在战后换人，以凯撒接触融合和战车控制场面。
extra: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
combo: 救援猫按当前卡文处理：登场怪兽效果无效，仍可用作合法素材。
剑斗兽必须参加战斗才有通常的战后换人机会；接触融合会把素材洗回卡组。
decks.sideSourceStatus: The source supplied no complete Side Deck. These 15 game-adapted counterplay cards cover graveyard interaction, summon interruption and back-row or monster removal within the OCG candidate year. They are not a player-original transcription.

decks.title: 猫僧同调
decks.description: 2009前三有两套黑羽，因此第三套选同年热门猫僧同调。召唤僧、救援猫、X-剑士和炎狱提供不同等级组合，奥金魔术师处理场面。
extra: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Gaia Knight, the Force of Earth
combo: 召唤僧的魔法弃牌是代价；先看卡组里是否还有合法4星展开目标。
奥金魔术师要求非调整魔法师族；御用守护者按当前卡文要求地属性调整。
decks.sideSourceStatus: The source supplied no complete Side Deck. These 15 game-adapted counterplay cards cover graveyard interaction, summon interruption and back-row or monster removal within the OCG candidate year. They are not a player-original transcription.

decks.title: 蛙炮循环
decks.description: 参考2010世界冠军 Galileo De Obaldia 的 Frog FTK 引擎改编。交换蛙、替代蛙和粹蛙把卡组与墓地变成资源，以质量加速器完成循环削血。
extra: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Gungnir, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
combo: 粹蛙除外墓地青蛙复活；粹蛙自身不是青蛙，且不能作同调素材。
质量加速器每次实际解放一只怪兽造成400伤害；展开和削血均可被合法响应打断。
decks.sideSourceStatus: The source supplied no complete Side Deck. These 15 game-adapted counterplay cards cover graveyard interaction, summon interruption and back-row or monster removal within the OCG candidate year. They are not a player-original transcription.

decks.title: 黑羽旋风
decks.description: 参考2010世界亚军黑羽的全年代表构筑，加入精锐、微风与黑羽宝札。协调通常召唤检索、墓地同调与反击陷阱。
main: Blackwing - Vayu the Emblem of Honor
extra: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
combo: 强欲而谦虚之壶和黑羽宝札会封锁本回合特殊召唤，先确定本回合的路线。
精锐返回自己一张表侧卡复活，需要支付400生命值。
decks.sideSourceStatus: The source supplied no complete Side Deck. These 15 game-adapted counterplay cards cover graveyard interaction, summon interruption and back-row or monster removal within the OCG candidate year. They are not a player-original transcription.

decks.title: 神光宣告
decks.description: 参考2010世界季军 Kuwano Kei 的宣告者体系。准备仪式、精确等级解放与天使手牌支撑神光；大天使的特殊召唤封锁形成另一种胜法。
main: Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
extra: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
combo: 宣告者的预言要求等级合计恰好6；高等仪式术从卡组送墓通常怪兽。
神光每次无效都要送墓一张天使手牌，不能把有限手牌当作无限响应。
decks.sideSourceStatus: The source supplied no complete Side Deck. These 15 game-adapted counterplay cards cover graveyard interaction, summon interruption and back-row or monster removal within the OCG candidate year. They are not a player-original transcription.

decks.title: 代行天使
decks.description: 参考2011世界冠军 Ogawa Takashi 的代行天使。地球检索、金星召唤球体，连接同调与2阶超量；主宰者将墓地天使转为去除。
extra: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
combo: 金星每次支付500生命值召唤一只神圣球体；两只球体可以叠放成2阶超量。
主宰者以代行者为特殊召唤资源，再消耗光属性天使发动破坏。
decks.sideSourceStatus: The source supplied no complete Side Deck. These 15 game-adapted counterplay cards cover graveyard interaction, summon interruption and back-row or monster removal within the OCG candidate year. They are not a player-original transcription.

decks.title: 废二同调
decks.description: 参考2011世界亚军与季军共同使用的 Junk Doppel。保留一套废二，用二重身衍生物、植物调整和图书馆衔接加速同调。
extra: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
combo: 方程式是同调调整；流天类加速路线要求同调怪兽素材，不能只看等级合计。
成长的鳞茎和孢子各有整场一次限制；二重身由墓地特殊召唤触发。
decks.sideSourceStatus: The source supplied no complete Side Deck. These 15 game-adapted counterplay cards cover graveyard interaction, summon interruption and back-row or monster removal within the OCG candidate year. They are not a player-original transcription.

decks.title: 六武真传
decks.description: 2011冠亚季军有两套废二，因此加入当年热门、世界赛八强也使用的六武众。影武者与影鬼出紫炎，道场和团结补充资源。
extra: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Gaia Knight, the Force of Earth
combo: 影鬼通常召唤展开影武者，2星调整加3星六武众同调真六武众 紫炎。
紫炎每回合无效一次魔法或陷阱；破坏代替会实际消耗另一只六武众。
decks.sideSourceStatus: The source supplied no complete Side Deck. These 15 game-adapted counterplay cards cover graveyard interaction, summon interruption and back-row or monster removal within the OCG candidate year. They are not a player-original transcription.

decks.title: 甲虫装机
decks.description: 2012世界赛前四均为甲虫装机。保留冠军代表体系，以蜻蜓、蜈蚣和大黄蜂的装备送墓形成展开，瓢虫调整等级进入不同阶级。
combo: 大黄蜂作为装备卡送墓是发动代价，随后宿主蜻蜓或蜈蚣获得各自的诱发机会。
瓢虫能改变等级；超量必须核对当前等级，叠放后的卡片不再是场上怪兽。
decks.sideSourceStatus: The source supplied no complete Side Deck. These 15 game-adapted counterplay cards cover graveyard interaction, summon interruption and back-row or monster removal within the OCG candidate year. They are not a player-original transcription.

decks.title: 发条连动
decks.description: 为避免三套甲虫装机重复，选入2012全年人气体系发条。鲨鱼调整等级，魔术师与老鼠展开，发条空母连接3阶超量。
combo: 多数发条怪兽每次表侧存在期间只能用一次效果；暂时除外或盖放重置与普通回合限制不同。
空母移除一枚真实素材展开，老鼠变为守备表示复活发条。
decks.sideSourceStatus: The source supplied no complete Side Deck. These 15 game-adapted counterplay cards cover graveyard interaction, summon interruption and back-row or monster removal within the OCG candidate year. They are not a player-original transcription.

decks.title: 水精鳞海皇
decks.description: 以2012下半年登场的水精鳞海皇补足第三种玩法。水属性弃牌代价触发海皇，深渊球调度琳德，巨齿深渊鲨与水属性额外完成进攻。
extra: Gungnir, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
combo: 海皇只在为水属性怪兽效果支付送墓代价时触发；普通效果送墓不能混用。
深渊球在场时不能发动魔法；它离场会破坏关联怪兽，琳德可接续卡组特殊召唤。
